entities.summary: Lars-Erik Vilner Larsson was a Swedish composer, conductor, radio producer, and educator. He wrote three of the most popular works in Swedish art music: A Winter's Tale, the Pastoral Suite, and God in Disguise. Other notable works by Larsson include three symphonies, a sinfonietta, and numerous concertante works.
